title: Blackholes alternative to String Theory - Inverse Portal Theory
summary: We present a geometric interpretation of black holes as dimensional crossover points where the effective dimension D(r) converges to zero at the center. At this crossover, photons are absorbed and then spit out into an inverse world where the sky is light and the stars are black. A continuity equation with a divergence at D=0 and a jump condition at the crossover describes photon flux between the two worlds, providing a unified explanation for black hole thermodynamics and cosmic background radiation without the need for extra dimensions.

review.reason: Proposes an alternative black hole framework using inverse-world photon flux, without extra dimensions.
